# Tableau sources (regenerated by notebooks/selector.ipynb, section 8)

Re-run the notebook and these files are rewritten from the training results (CSVs are byte-identical across runs).

| File | Grain | Use |
|---|---|---|
| `graph_strategy_long.csv` | graph x strategy (62 x 3 = 186) | main source: runtime vs `max_vertex_work` (log), crossover, regret by graph; filter on `protocol`, `family`, `hub_count` |
| `policy_scores.csv` | scheme x policy (21) | mean regret / speed-up / total time per policy; `scheme` = LOGO / LOSG / SEED202 |
| `classifier_scores.csv` | scheme x model (21) | accuracy next to the `majority` row (always show it) |
| `cv_predictions_logo.csv` | graph (62) | confusion matrix (true_class vs pred_class_logo_<model>) |
| `selector_results.hyper` | all four tables in one Tableau extract | Tableau: Connect -> More -> Hyper file (written when `tableauhyperapi` is installed) |
| `dashboard_preview.png` | — | the dashboard (KPI row + 6 sheets) drawn in the notebook from these files |

Tableau: Connect -> Text file -> `graph_strategy_long.csv`; add the other CSVs as separate data sources (different grains, do not join). Sheet recipes and calculated fields: `docs/TABLEAU_GUIDE.md`.
